column1: # Autoroute-probe fixtures (A01). Columns are tab separated.
# A row "ladder<TAB>path..." defines the fixture ladder of the A series (A01.1): the small boards
# of the autoroute research's fixture table, smallest first. Every other row is
# "<kind><TAB>path..." and names the fixtures of one probe kind; "@ladder" stands for the whole
# ladder and "-" for no fixture (the output is then <kind>/<kind>.jsonl). Paths are below the
# repository root. Later checklists append their kinds; none rewrites another's row.
